method: Read immutable Git objects and compare valid-input arithmetic, bounds, conversion state, representation, lifetime and cleanup against public declarations. Trace in-corpus scanner wrappers and preserve excluded primitive/allocator/syscall dependencies.

findings.evidence: strtod.c:166-167 accumulates signed int exp before clamp; 1e2147483648 overflows a 32-bit int.
findings.next_action: Execute renamed baseline with signed-overflow instrumentation and independent range/end-offset oracle; repair bounded exponent arithmetic.

findings.evidence: strtod.c:93-114,158-168 accepts incomplete exponent suffixes and non-C exponent markers, misses newline whitespace and C17 hex/INF/NAN forms.
findings.next_action: Establish required C17 conversion profile and run grammar, value and exact end-offset cases before selecting complete repair.

findings.evidence: strtod.c:129-151 retains first 18 digits including zeros; 0000000000000000001 converts to zero.
findings.next_action: Reproduce exact expected value 1 and repair significant-digit collection with calibrated controls.

findings.evidence: strtod.c:187-196 forms 10^310 before division; binary64 input 100000000000000000e-310 can become zero instead of approximately 1e-293.
findings.next_action: Confirm target double geometry, reproduce positive-normal result and evaluate resource-bounded scaling or complete donor implementation.

findings.evidence: heapsort.c:166 forms (char *)vbase-size before the array even for a valid two-element input; ordinary sort success does not establish C pointer-domain validity.
findings.next_action: Trace one-based indexing and signed counters; choose zero-based bounds-preserving design and verify sorting/permutation/error contracts.
Attach getopt interface authority and independent option/optind cases before final classification.

limitations: Source inspection only; tests and builds were excluded.
Per-path residuals preserve excluded implementations, callers, compiler arithmetic and locale/type dependencies.
Caller-invalid strings, NULL pointers, prohibited overlaps, invalid comparators, unrepresentable absolute values/quotients and zero division are outside the stated valid-input review.
Shared narrow/wide scanner agreement supplies one shared implementation assumption rather than an independent oracle.

path_dispositions.disposition: Source/object membership agrees; warning policy delegates through WARNLEVEL=legacy. Actual archive freshness and flags remain unverified.
Delegates status to _exit and prevents return; syscall termination and stream effects remain dependencies.
Delegates base-10 conversion to strtoll with NULL end pointer; unrepresentable results excluded by interface.
Halves size_t search interval and advances right base for valid sorted storage/comparator; comparator correctness and storage belong to caller.
Clusters, option arguments, reset and globals reviewed; --x delimiter behavior is an open contract candidate; static continuation limits interleaving.
Splits writable input and searches NULL-terminated tokens; whitespace/comma extensions and global unknown-token semantics require intended BSD/POSIX authority.
Trivial input, zero size and allocation failure reviewed; before-array pointer formation and signed counters require repair analysis.
Negates negative representable magnitudes; INTMAX_MIN absolute value excluded by interface.
Unsigned magnitudes and 64 restoring steps reviewed under declared types; zero denominator and unrepresentable quotient excluded; inttypes definition remains dependency.
State query, zero length, NUL and single byte reviewed for stateless byte encoding; locale integration remains separate.
Count-only or at most n stores with fitting NUL reviewed; valid disjoint objects required; strlen and wchar definition remain dependencies.
Reset, zero length, optional output and unsigned-byte widening reviewed; declared one-byte encoding excludes UTF-8 interpretation.
Product checked before realloc; rejection preserves original ownership; allocator and SIZE_MAX definition remain dependencies.
Mantissa scan/retention, exponent grammar, signed accumulation and scaling reviewed; overflow, incomplete exponents, leading-zero loss and scale overflow remain open.
Delegates to strtoll; intmax_t equivalence requires inttypes definition.
Base validation, whitespace/sign/prefix, unsigned cutoff, clamping, end pointer and signed minimum reviewed; actual limits and execution remain separate.
Signed boundary handling over scanner magnitude reviewed; shared scanner and integer limits remain dependencies.
Internal magnitude/sign/overflow result and scanner interface reviewed; wide-type prerequisite remains dependency.
Initial end pointer, base validation, validated prefixes, four-limb accumulation and continued overflow scan reviewed for bases 2-36; narrow/wide share one oracle assumption.
Unsigned cutoff, post-conversion negation and end pointer reviewed; target limits and execution remain separate.
Unsigned-byte scanner instantiation, clamp and negation reviewed; -1 maps to unsigned maximum as intended.
Delegates to strtoull; intmax type equivalence remains dependency.
Signed wide boundary handling reviewed; shared scanner, types and locale integration remain dependencies.
Bounded stores, wide rejection and count-only path reviewed for one-byte encoding; negative wide values reject by unsigned conversion.
Wide scanner, overflow clamp and unsigned negate reviewed; locale and type definitions remain dependencies.
State query and one-byte representability reviewed for 0..UCHAR_MAX; encoding/errno authority remains dependency.
